# Ellen MacArthur Foundation

> > Leading global charity accelerating the transition to a circular economy through research, education, and business innovation.

The Ellen MacArthur Foundation works with businesses, governments, and academia to build a framework for an economy that is restorative and regenerative by design. The organization provides resources, tools, and insights to help organizations transition from linear to circular economic models.

## Key Topics

- Circular economy
- Sustainability
- Regenerative design
- Business innovation
- Systems thinking
- Resource efficiency
- Digital asset management
- Authentication and access
- SAML SSO
- Content portal
- File management

## Digital Resources & Portal Access

- [EMF Portal](https://content.ellenmacarthurfoundation.org/): Login portal for Ellen MacArthur Foundation digital asset manager - access educational materials, research documents, and collaborative resources
